"field": "🔹(⬛) subJSONready",
"type": "formula",
"formulaValue": "  NOT(
    OR(
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"subKEY"\\s*:\\s*"rec[^"]+"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"subRecordId"\\s*:\\s*"rec[^"]+"')),

      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"subPhase1"\\s*:\\s*\\{[\\s\\S]*"serviceArea"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"state"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"county"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"city"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"')),

      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"subPhase2"\\s*:\\s*\\[[\\s\\S]*"incomeCheck"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"calc"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"percent"\\s*:\\s*"?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?"?')),

      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"subPhase3"\\s*:\\s*\\{[\\s\\S]*"ownershipCheck"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"typeHome"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"bldgValue"\\s*:\\s*"?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?"?')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"primaryRes"\\s*:\\s*"?(true|false)"?')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"ownHome"\\s*:\\s*"?(true|false)"?')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"ownLot"\\s*:\\s*"?(true|false)"?')),
      NOT(REGEX_MATCH({fldyDbkvKDNH4xZO9}&"", '"minTime"\\s*:\\s*"?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?"?'))

}

        DATETIME_DIFF(TODAY(), {fldfOEpSN950udIzj}, "days") < 30,
        DATETIME_DIFF(TODAY(), {fldfOEpSN950udIzj}, "weeks") &
        " week" &
        IF(DATETIME_DIFF(TODAY(), {fldfOEpSN950udIzj}, "weeks") = 1, "", "s") &
        " ago",
        IF(
          DATETIME_DIFF(TODAY(), {fldfOEpSN950udIzj}, "days") < 365,
          DATETIME_DIFF(TODAY(), {fldfOEpSN950udIzj}, "months") &
          " month" &
